title: The cloud submission record cannot carry a selected run config
body:
tick tda's design names `ticfac run <epic> [--cloud] --config claude`, but the factory's POST /api/runs submission record has no field for a config, so a --cloud run cannot carry the operator's word: this tick refuses the combination honestly, naming what a submitted run selects by (the epic's own config: label and the declared default). Wiring it needs the factory's TypeScript intake (the submission record and the orchestrator hand-off) and the in-factory run-epic invocation — a factory-side tick. Until it lands, only a --cloud-workers run (orchestrator on this machine) can select a config by flag in a cloud-workers run.
evidence: internal/cli/run.go (the --cloud --config refusal, 'the cloud submission carries no --config'); internal/cli/run_cloud.go submitCloudRun's submission struct (Project/Epic/BaseSHA/RequestedBy/Queue/Orchestrator/Substrate — no config field)
